hullSideRight.note: Hull right side — Wikinger OstHeer skin (German Balkenkreuz on hull). Two white crosses are visible at the bottom-right area of the 2048x2048 atlas. This rect covers the left cross of the two (right-side hull panel). Cross center estimated at approximately (1560,1790) from visual inspection of annotated PNG. Second cross is at ~(1680,1790). The StuG III hull atlas unwraps with the hull-right panel in the lower-right quadrant.
